title: Keep your circuit

blocks.md:
## Yours to keep

Passing **Make the lamp brighter** saved your world under this learner's `creations/` folder. That circuit can now sit at a bright, safe current — something it could not do at the start. **Export creation** in the studio writes those files off this machine. Settings export will not include it. A creation is progress, not a pack of teaching content.

This bites when you assume a reinstall or a settings backup will carry the circuit. Packs are lessons other people wrote. Your tuned loop lives with the learner until you export it. Leave it here and a new machine starts dim again.

```text
battery → resistor(1 Ω) → lamp → battery
bright, current 1, cap 2
```

A common mistake is treating this page as another ohms puzzle. There is no new circuit to tune. The prompt asks you to say, in one sentence, why lowering resistance made the lamp brighter and why `0.25` was a bad idea.

blocks.promptMd: In one sentence: why did lowering resistance make the lamp brighter, and why was 0.25 a bad idea?

description: Keep the circuit you built and take it with you.
